title: Universality and Heterogeneity of Stylized Facts in Cryptocurrency and Equity Markets
abstract: arXiv:2608.10852v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This study investigates whether the macroscopic statistical maturity of cryptocurrencies implies dynamical equivalence with an equity-market benchmark. We analyze one-minute data (2020--2025) for Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and E-mini S\&P~500 futures using the Complexity--Entropy Causality Plane (CECP) and directed horizontal visibility graphs (DHVG). While conventional stylized facts overlap across the analyzed assets, cryptocurrencies exhibit weaker local ordinal organization and a larger divergence between their high-degree in- and out-visibility distributions relative to matched surrogate baselines under the primary specification. This high-degree separation is strongest at the one-minute scale and weakens under 5- and 10-minute aggregation, while the direction of the underlying asymmetry remains more asset- and preprocessing-dependent. translated_title: 加密货币市场与股票市场中风格化事实的普遍性与异质性
translated_abstract: 本研究考察加密货币的宏观统计成熟度是否意味着其与股票市场基准具有动力学等价性。我们使用复杂度-熵因果关系平面（CECP）和有向水平可见图（DHVG）分析了比特币、以太坊、XRP和E-mini标普500期货2020至2025年的一分钟数据。尽管常规的风格化事实在所分析的资产之间存在重叠，但在主要设定下，加密货币相对于匹配的替代数据基准表现出更弱的局部序数组织，以及高入度和高出度可见性分布之间更大的差异。这种高度数分离在一分钟尺度上最强，并在5分钟和10分钟聚合下减弱，而潜在不对称性的方向则更加依赖于具体资产和预处理方式。因此我们仅能得出结论：宏观相似性可以与特定诊断指标下的（异质性）共存。
tldr: 该研究发现加密货币与股票市场在宏观统计特征上高度相似，但通过复杂度-熵因果关系平面和有向可见图分析，揭示了加密货币在一分钟尺度上存在独特的弱局部序数组织和高度数分布不对称性，表明宏观相似性与诊断层面的异质性可以共存。
en_tdlr: While cryptocurrencies exhibit macroscopic statistical similarity to equity markets, complexity-entropy causality plane and directed horizontal visibility graph analyses reveal weaker local ordinal organization and high-degree distribution asymmetry in cryptocurrencies at the one-minute scale, showing that macroscopic equivalence can coexist with diagnostic-specific heterogeneity.
